title: World première of Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
The Imagine film had its US première on 23 December 1972.

The feature film by John Lennon and Yoko Ono was filmed at their Tittenhurst Park home in Ascot, England, and at a variety of locations in London and New York between May and September 1971. The soundtrack included every song from Lennon’s Imagine album, plus six songs from Ono’s Fly.

The film opened at the Liverpool Odeon, Leicester Picture House, and Nottingham Odeon in England, before a wider release across the UK and in other countries. Its US première was in New York City at the Whitney Museum of American Art on 11 January 1973.
